subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about cost-per-sale web orders for {Brand}. Statistics Canada put ecommerce at 5.7% of retail in November 2025, about 4.0 billion of a 70.4 billion total, so online share keeps climbing while general ecommerce CPAs sit roughly between 68 and 86 dollars. That is the spread where paying per validated sale rather than per click decides your real cost, the way Best Buy would benchmark a web partner. We hold out a control group so paid orders read as incremental. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: StatCan Nov-2025 ecommerce share shift (sourced) + ecommerce CPA band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN ecommerce CPS: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (StatCan Nov-2025 ecommerce share 5.7% / $4.0B of $70.4B, sourced via Eightx) + ecommerce CPA band $68-$86 (sourced via Prospeo); names Best Buy from brand_candidates as quality benchmark; MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference carries no figure so no illustrative flag; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; market context is web-verified; native English; no em-dash, no X-not-Y (rephrased to positive).
